messages: SELECT r.id AS id, t.id AS conversation_id, t.customer_id AS member_id, c.full_name AS member_name, c.email AS email, CASE WHEN r.author_kind = 'staff' THEN 'agent' ELSE 'member' END AS sender, r.author_name AS agent_name, r.content AS body, r.created_at AS sent_at, r.is_bot AS automated FROM replies r JOIN tickets t ON t.id = r.ticket_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id
subscriptions: SELECT customer_id AS member_id, plan AS tier, state AS status, changed_at AS started_at FROM plan_changes
